scope: One declared same-context diagnostic; not a new acceptance matrix or causal proof.
limits: No rerun or threshold adjustment; this diagnostic cannot replace the retained failures.
Preallocated image capture still perturbs the next member; actual gap is retained, never subtracted.
A difference of marginal percentiles is not the percentile of paired differences; both are named separately.
Stage percentiles are descriptive; attribution must use same-frame correlated stages and differential source.
No per-frame allocation, CPU-frequency or thread-scheduling attribution is available.
